text:
PCM TRAINING

A shared language
for understanding
one another
16 hours · in Estonian, English or Russian · in Tallinn or on-site across Estonia
ASK FOR TRAINING DATES

WHAT PARTICIPANTS LEARN

Practise PCM in four steps:
Be aware of your personality

Understand your own preferences, psychological needs and the conditions that help you stay resourceful.

Recognise what others do, say and show

Learn to notice observable patterns in words, tone, behaviour and reactions instead of relying only on assumptions.

Adapt your communication style

Choose how to speak and respond so the message is easier for a different person to hear and use.

Build stronger relationships

Use those skills in everyday conversations, meetings, feedback, pressure and difficult moments.

HOW TRAINING WORKS

Theory only matters
when you can use it.
01
Understand the model

Participants get a clear, practical introduction to PCM and its core concepts.

02
Connect it to real situations

Examples, discussions and exercises link the model to conversations participants already recognise from work.

03
Practise different responses

The focus is not on memorising labels. It is on noticing more and having more options when communication matters.

TRAINING FORMATS

Choose the depth that fits:
PCM Core Training

For teams and open groups

The full foundation of PCM: perception, communication channels, psychological needs and stress patterns.

It includes the official 26-page PCM personality profile.

A strong starting point for teams that want a common framework they can continue using after the training.

16 hours · ET / EN / RU

Explore Core Training
PCM Leadership

For leaders and managers

The core model through a leadership lens: adapting communication, motivating different people and responding to stress more effectively.

Participants receive an extended Leadership Profile with additional material relevant to leading others.

Leadership-focused programme

Explore Leadership Training
Advanced Training

For deeper practice

For people who already know the PCM foundations and want to deepen their ability to recognise patterns and use the model more precisely.

The focus moves from understanding the framework to using it with greater fluency.

For previous PCM participants

Explore Advanced Training

INDIVIDUAL PROFILE

A personal map
inside a shared model

PCM training includes the official PCM personality profile. The standard profile is 26 pages and gives each participant a personal view of personality structure, communication preferences, psychological needs and stress patterns.

Leadership participants receive an extended profile with additional material relevant to leading others.

26-page personal PCM profile

HOW TEAMS BENEFIT

How PCM training supports teams
Fewer conflicts

Differences are recognised earlier, before they harden into personal tension.

Greater team comfort

People have more ways to communicate without constantly pushing against each other.

Stronger mutual understanding

Team members can make more sense of behaviour that previously felt confusing or frustrating.

More balanced participation

Different communication styles have more room to contribute.

Stronger team stability

A shared framework makes difficult periods easier to navigate together.

Increased satisfaction

People are more likely to feel understood, respected and able to work in ways that suit them.

What participants say

“Thanks to PCM, I can understand my conversation partner and the situation more quickly. This means that less energy is expended and decisions are made more quickly.”

Artur

“Now I have the tools to adapt to different communication styles and avoid unnecessary conflicts.”

Nikolai

“It was very interesting, clear and practical. I will definitely approach communication more effectively now.”

Tamara

“Many of the things taught there can be used in everyday life and at work. While studying psychology at university takes five years to learn how to classify personality types and character traits, here, in a couple of days, it becomes clear how to communicate and interact with different types of people.”

Aljona
Not sure which training fits?

Tell me about your team, the situation you are facing and what you would like to improve. We can choose the right starting point from there.

BOOK A FREE 20-MINUTE INTRODUCTION CALL
